items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: Clint Eastwood ... said ... 'he and Jessica Walter in the redwood forest.'

ctx.x: Yeah. Well I thought it was somebody goof — why would Clint Eastwood call me? And then he goes, “hey listen” you know and I go woah, I go, “hello Mr. Eastwood.” It’s like that Simpsons guy that gets on the bus all the time. So he said, “listen I just directed my first film — oh and all the time, “First Time Ever I Saw Your Face,” all the jazz disc jockeys said anytime they put that record on the phones lit up at the station. So I went to the guys at Atlantic in the singles place and I said, “we’ve got to put this…

station in New Orleans that said we’re getting a hundred calls a day for this song, but it’s too long, we have like a three minute and ten second or some kind of time limit on AM radio. So all right I’ll edit it. So I edit it, and there was no overnight then, we sent it by special delivery to the radio station. I said, “what do you think of those edits,” you know, “fit your format?” So the guy’s hemming and hawing, I said, “what’s the matter?” He said, “well, my secretary listened to it and she doesn’t like the…
